blocks.text:
Linkin Park's piano riff sits high, above the treble staff, on short extra lines.

**By the end** you can read up to high C above the staff and play the riff with your right hand.

blocks.caption: Numb, a piano arrangement (PDMX): the riff (the score shows it from bar 1; the music starts with three quick notes just before). ▶ to hear it.

blocks.text:
# Ledger lines above
Above the top line (F) the staff goes on with short **ledger lines**, just for the notes that need them: **G** sits just above the top line, **A** on the first ledger line, **B** above it, **C** on the second ledger line. The riff uses **E** (top space), G, A, B and C.

blocks.title: Above the staff, up to high C
blocks.doneWhen: 16 of the 20 cards clean in one set

blocks.text:
# The rhythm
The riff starts with a pickup, three eighth notes E G E before bar 1, then long notes tied across the beat: syncopation again, as in Teen Spirit.

blocks.title: The riff's rhythm
blocks.doneWhen: 3 of the 4 cards clean in one set

blocks.title: The riff, right hand
blocks.about: Wait for me, right hand, bars 1–4.

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **You lose count of the ledger lines.** A is the first, C the second: count lines, not spaces.
- **The tied notes get played twice.** Play once and hold.

**Until the next lesson:** the note cards and the riff, each day.
